detailed_description: The Excel Viewer opens XLSX or XLS files in the browser and renders worksheet values in a table for quick inspection. You can switch between sheets, filter one column by text, and click column headers to sort the visible data. It is useful for checking simple spreadsheets without opening Microsoft Excel. The viewer focuses on tabular cell values and does not preserve workbook styling, charts, formulas, macros, multi-column sorting, regex filters, or export controls.
usage_steps: Upload an XLSX or XLS file from your device.
Use the sheet tabs to switch between worksheets when multiple sheets exist.
Choose a filter column and enter text to narrow the displayed rows.
Click a column header to sort ascending, descending, or clear the sort.
Review the parsed table directly in the page.
usage_examples: Review a client spreadsheet and sort one revenue column to inspect the largest values.
Filter a simple task list by one status column while preparing a quick update.
Switch between sheets in a workbook to check parsed table values.
Open a spreadsheet on a device that does not have a desktop office app installed.
